description: This file defines an interface 'AkkaReplicatorConfig' that provides configuration settings for the Akka 'Replicator' in a distributed data system. It includes methods to retrieve the replicator's name, cluster role, and complete configuration, along with an enumeration for known configuration path expressions and default values.

classes.name: AkkaReplicatorConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for the Akka Replicator, including methods for getting the name, role, complete configuration, and an enumeration for default config values.

classes.name: AkkaReplicatorConfig.AkkaReplicatorConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of configuration path expressions and default values for the Akka Replicator configuration.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the replicator.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the cluster role of members with replicas of the distributed collection.

methods.name: getCompleteConfig
methods.description: Gets the complete Akka 'distributed-data' config for the Replicator.
